items.summary: Recipe fill-in exercise and a family dinner dialogue practising food vocabulary and negation.
Birthday-dinner chat and a rainy-day pizza picnic story with true/false and matching tasks.
Contest entries describing healthy meals, answered through short questions and a listening fill-in.
Reading about Ramadan, Thanksgiving and Diwali traditions and foods, with comprehension and translation.
Vocabulary summary for meals, drinks, breakfast foods, and polite phrases about food.
Rappel 4 review: vowels, word lists, gender endings, verb forms, and possessives.
Word-building, a cat's daily routine, and matching questions with answers on mixed topics.
Introduces sports vocabulary via a listening-matching activity and a reading on French summer holidays.
Matching sport pictures to sentences and English translations, plus a faire-conjugation dialogue.
Matching musical instruments to photos and completing sentences with jouer de + instrument.
Reading about young musicians and France's nationwide Fete de la Musique festival.
Matching leisure activities to photos, practising jouer/faire expressions, plus listening interviews.
Reading a hobbies forum then writing a personal message about leisure activities.
Listening to identify past leisure activities and distinguishing present versus perfect tense.
Writing and speaking practice describing past sport/music activities using the perfect tense.
Reading about Asterix and Parc Asterix, with true/false correction and photo-matching exercises.
Parc Asterix hours and prices practised via Q&A, listening, and 24-hour clock matching.
Reading a theme-park contest entry, correcting errors, then writing about an ideal or awful day.
A cousin's chat about theme-park tickets, plus listening practice with je suis alle(e).
A leisure personality quiz completed with vocabulary and scored with an answer key.
Vocabulary summary for sport, music, the 24-hour clock, and past-tense phrases.
Comic strip about a greedy cat's feast, followed by vocabulary translation and word-finding tasks.
A holiday song plus reading passages on volleyball, windsurfing, and judo with comprehension questions.
Review exercises matching numbers, greetings, and question-answer pairs for basic introductions.
Review exercises on prepositions of place, saying where you live, and naming objects.
Review exercises on siblings, possessive adjectives, and describing a house via listening.
A Saturday photo-story fill-in on etre, followed by a writing task about family.
Counting pets, identifying a lost cat by phone call, and describing invented animals.
Odd-one-out vocabulary game and a true/false reading about siblings' differing feelings toward pets.
Review of months and calendar dates, then true/false reading of French festival adverts.
